test_unicode_casters: test the pybind11 unicode conversion functions for utf8, utf16, utf32, and wchar string roundtrips
test_single_char_casters: test the pybind11 single character casters for char, char16, char32, and wchar ord conversions
test_integer_casters: test the pybind11 integer casting functions for i32, i64, u32, and u64 type conversions
test_tuple_casters: test the pybind11 std::pair and std::tuple to Python tuple casting and roundtrip conversions
test_bool_casters: test the pybind11 bool caster implicit conversions for native bools and objects with __bool__
